added.name: Assemble
added.long_description: Assemble accelerates IT teams by performing development work inside core enterprise systems like ERP, CRM, and HRIS. Our agents help IT teams scope dependencies, build logic, and validate changes across your systems.

added.name: OneCLI
added.long_description:
OneCLI is a credential isolation gateway for AI agents. Agents see placeholder tokens instead of real API keys and OAuth credentials, the real secrets are injected at the network layer, so a compromised or misbehaving agent can never leak them. 

Teams get per-agent access control, full audit logs, and one-click integrations with Gmail, GitHub, Jira, Slack, and 50+ other apps. OneCLI is open source (2.5K+ GitHub stars, 300K+ downloads), Already the default credential layer for products like NanoClaw.
added.one_liner: The Identity Gateway for AI Agents

Vulcan builds agents for government and government-adjacent work. We currently sell two agents: Justinian and Trajan.

Justinian is an AI agent coworker for people who work in and adjacent to American government. To power Justinian, we created the world’s largest legal and policy database, accessible to our customers via our platform, email, and Slack.

In addition to government customers, Vulcan's agents serve regulatory, legal, policy, and government relations teams at major U.S. enterprises.

long_description.before:
We build AI scientists that discover new materials for the semiconductor industry - specifically datacenters and fabs. Finding novel materials today takes 10+ years of lab work. We aim to compress that timeline to months, using a swarm of AI agents.

Akash completed his PhD at Stanford on material discovery for semiconductors. The materials he discovered for nanoscale interconnects have been adopted into the roadmaps of Intel and TSMC. Advaith was the founding applied scientist at Persona AI (acquired by Luma Labs), where he built long horizon autonomous agents for major telecom and crypto companies.

Power consumption and heat release from AI chips is doubling every year. The semiconductor industry needs new materials to keep this exponential going - Matforge will help find them.

long_description.before: Ara (YC P26) is the self-driving engineer for software teams. Ara turns coding into a closed loop: suggest, act, learn, improve.
long_description.after: Ara is the cloud coding agent — an autonomous software engineer for software teams. It watches work in progress, plans the next step, and executes tasks with its own computer, background agents, persistent memory, and reusable skills. Unite your team that uses Claude and Codex and other  coding subscriptions to code together in the browser. Ara turns coding into a closed loop: suggest, act, learn, improve.

long_description.before:
Resumes made careers readable. LinkedIn made them searchable. Pluto makes them understood.

Professionals talk to Pluto for 10 minutes about what they’ve done, what they’re great at, and what they want next. Pluto makes that context discoverable to the right people and AI agents, giving them a fuller picture of the professional beyond the resume.

For hiring, companies tell Pluto who they want to meet. Pluto searches its network and the broader market, evaluates fit on both sides, privately confirms interest, and makes warm introductions when both sides want to connect.

17K+ professionals have shared their career context with Pluto. More than 100 companies, from fast-growing startups to decacorns, have used Talentpluto to meet people with deeper context and confirmed interest.
